Name: Zayne (Love and Deepspace) - Custom NPC
Author: zaynesbeloved
Description:
[quote][i][b]Disclaimer[/b]: This is a personal project that I started working on a while ago, and my first time doing something like this. This is experimental, since I am learning everything along the way. Also, I cannot guarantee that this mod will work as it is supposed to with other mods. Compatibility was not something I had in mind, so I suggest playing without mods that add custom NPCs or maps. If requested, then I will try working on compatibility with certain mods. (˶ˆ꒳ˆ˵)[/i][/quote][i][size=2][b]Installation[/b]:[b] [/b][/size][/i]
[list]
[*][i][size=2]Install Smapi (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)[/size][/i][/*]
[*][i][size=2]Install Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)[/size][/i][/*]
[*][i][size=2]Download this mod[/size][/i][/*]
[*][i][size=2]Unzip this mod into Stardew Valley/Mods folder in your files[/size][/i][/*]
[/list][i][b]What to expect[/b]:
So far, he has about 100 dialogue lines, but no marriage dialogue. He doesn't have any heart events just yet. I will add more content to him with time, so I kindly ask you to be patient with me~♡(੭´͈ ᐜ `͈)੭ 

[b]Known issues[/b]: (つ╥﹏╥)つ[/i]
[list]
[*][i][i]When giving him a bouquet or a pendant, the default dialogue appears.[/i][/i][/*]
[/list][i]Before releasing this mod and its updates, I tried my best to fix any and all bugs I encountered. However, there might be some aspects that I won't notice, so if you encounter any other bugs, feel free to contact me. ⸜(｡˃ ᵕ ˂ )⸝♡

[b]Content I will add in the future[/b]: ദ്ദി(˵ •̀ ᴗ - ˵ )[/i]
